name: thinkmate
description: AI thinking partner for major life decisions: Decision Studio, calibration, and an adaptive expert council. Product overview; source is private.

paragraphs: An AI thinking partner that helps people work through major life decisions such as career, money, relationships, health, and direction.

Large personal decisions are usually made alone, or with general-purpose chatbots that answer every question the same way. ThinkMate is built around one companion that remembers who the user is, asks back, and adapts its answer to the situation. A choice gets a verdict, the reasoning, what could fail, and next steps. Grief or exhaustion gets presence first, and analysis only when the user asks for it.
The companion does not decide for the user. Each question convenes only the disciplines that bear on it, drawn from a catalogue of 47 fields.
features: Decision Studio: a saved canvas with options, scores from an expert panel, short- and long-term scenarios, a risk map with mitigations, and a recommendation.
Decision calibration: users record their confidence when choosing, and later reviews turn this into a calibration curve and a Brier score.
Adaptive expert council: per question, a subset of 47 fields, from humanistic lenses to medicine, law, tax, finance, software, and nutrition.
Self map: long-term memory of values, people, goals, and life chapters. Each memory carries a confidence level, and inferred memories are labelled as inferred.
Mood tracking, time capsules, and a weekly letter delivered by scheduled jobs and Web Push.
